title: If the singular ideal generates the unit ideal over Lambda the map factors through a smooth algebra

standard_prerequisites.name: Definition of the singular ideal
standard_prerequisites.use: H_{A/R} is generated by elements a with A_a smooth over R.

core_obligations: Choose f_1, ..., f_r in H_{A/R} and lambda_1, ..., lambda_r in Lambda with sum f_i lambda_i = 1.
Set B = A[x_1, ..., x_r]/(f_1 x_1 + ... + f_r x_r - 1) and map B to Lambda by x_i -> lambda_i; the relation maps to zero since the sum is 1.

Check smoothness of R -> B on the standard opens B_{f_i}: A_{f_i} is smooth over R by definition of H_{A/R}, and B_{f_i} is smooth over A_{f_i} because inverting f_i makes the equation linear in x_i, so B_{f_i} is a polynomial algebra over A_{f_i}; the opens B_{f_i} cover B because sum f_i x_i = 1 holds in B.
Conclude B is smooth over R and the composite A -> B -> Lambda is the wanted factorization.
proof_roadmap: Unit relation; quotient presentation mapping to Lambda; smoothness on the standard opens; covering of B.
difficulty_reason: A short explicit construction; the substantive step is the smoothness check on the opens B_{f_i}, which the source marks 'Details omitted'.
